thread:
sam: PR #9819 is ready but I'm blocking on arch signoff. RFC linked below. Can someone take a quick look? https://rwdinfradoc.internal/rfcs/2026-shard-affinity.md
maria: quick question — what does this change do to latency p95 for small requests? any SLO delta?
sam: should be negligible; added optional shard-affinity that favors hot KV-cache hits. p50/p95 modeled +0ms/+3ms under our load tests, CPU down ~5%. Canary plan included in the PR description.
ankur: can you paste the canary steps and the fallback plan here? also please put the RFC link in the PR body (not just in Slack). need arch ack before we merge.
sam: sure — canary steps:
```
1) deploy to canary pool (5% traffic) for 2h
2) monitor p95, error-rate, cache-hit ratio
3) rollback if p95 > +10ms or errors > 0.5%
```
fallback: route to compat variant (no shard affinity) automatically if autoscaler triggers >1 instance churn; cost of fallback ~+12ms.
devops-bot: CI / integration tests passed — all green (build 20260318.12) :white_check_mark:
maria: looks good to me, small nit about log verbosity — I'll add a quick comment on the PR. :thumbsup:
ankur: reading RFC now. main arch question: KV cache eviction behavior under multi-tenant bursts — confirm test coverage and can you add a short note in PR about fallback latency cost?
sam: added RFC link in PR body and a short note about fallback cost (~+12ms). also extended canary to 3h to be safe, updated rollout notes. tagging for merge window tomorrow 10:00 PT. @ankur please ACK when OK.
ankur: ack from arch, please proceed once the small nit is resolved.
sam: thanks — will merge in morning if no regressions.
